eyebrow: Six qualities, one at a time

items.label: Reproducible
items.sub: Runs the same way in dev, test, and prod

items.label: Tested
items.sub: Verified by something other than a human eyeballing it

items.label: Observable & alertable
items.sub: Health is visible; a human is notified before a user is

items.label: Recoverable & cost-aware
items.sub: A bad run can be undone; the cost is known and justified
